## DESCRIPTION (the main long-form body — paste everything below as the product description)

---

**Six AI agents. One full content drop in 90 seconds. One purchase, forever.**

You're running multiple content channels — YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, maybe a blog. Every week you need fresh ideas, scripts, hashtags, image prompts, video prompts. And you're paying $50–$200/month for AI tools that produce generic, lifeless output you can spot from a mile away.

**GEM flips that.** One purchase. Six specialist AI agents working as a pipeline. A complete content drop — script, image prompts, video prompts, carousels, per-platform captions — in about 90 seconds. Runs locally on Ollama for free, or against your own OpenAI / Anthropic / OpenRouter key. No server. No subscription. No account. Your data never leaves your computer.

---

### What you actually get on every run

Drop a single content idea in, hit Generate, walk away for 90 seconds. Come back to:

- **A 60-second YouTube Short script** — humanized, with [pause] markers and tension-before-reveal pacing
- **2 multi-slide carousels** — Instagram (7 slides) + LinkedIn (5 slides), each with role, headline copy, and image prompt per slide
- **5 photo post prompts per piece** — ready-to-paste ChatGPT / DALL-E 3 / Imagen prompts for IG Feed, IG Reel, FB, TikTok, LinkedIn
- **Master image prompts** for Midjourney v6, DALL-E 3, and FLUX.1 — every aspect ratio: thumbnail, story, cover, banner, hero
- **Scene-by-scene video prompts** for Kling AI and RunwayML
- **Per-channel captions** with platform-specific tone, length, and hashtags — YouTube SEO + IG Reel hook + FB hook + TikTok cover + LinkedIn post + blog intro
- **12 hashtags + best-time-to-post** suggestion per platform
- **Trending Mode** — live signals from Reddit, HackerNews, and Google Trends fold into the topic picker

---

### The six agents

1. **Brand Brain** — analyses your channels and niche, sets the voice, content pillars, and the anchor hook every downstream agent uses.
2. **Scout** — pulls live trend signals and ranks 5–6 topic candidates with viral scores, estimated views, and competition levels.
3. **Architect** — designs the section-by-section structure with retention hooks at 30s / 2m / 5m, an SEO title, and a thumbnail concept.
4. **Writer** — drafts the humanized voiceover script that passes the two-second hook test — no robotic listicle voice, no AI filler.
5. **Visual Director** — writes every image and video prompt for every platform, tuned per model (Midjourney syntax for MJ, natural language for DALL-E, etc.).
6. **Channel Adapter** — rewrites the master content per platform with the right tone, length, and hashtags. YouTube ≠ Instagram ≠ LinkedIn.

Each agent's output is graded against a six-rule **Quality Bar** before the next agent runs — one clear idea per post, two-second hook, specific examples (not generic advice), on-brand visuals, business-goal CTA, human approval beat. **You can rerun any single agent without rerunning the whole pipeline.**

---

### Run it your way — local or cloud

- **Ollama (free, local, 100% private):** install Ollama, pull `qwen2.5:14b` (or `:7b` for 8 GB systems), point GEM at `http://localhost:11434`. **Zero cost per run.** Nothing ever leaves your computer.
- **Cloud LLM (≈ 2–5¢ per run):** paste an OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter key. A full pipeline run costs about $0.02–$0.05 on `gpt-4o-mini` or about $0.12 on Claude Sonnet. **No GEM tax on top** — you pay the provider directly.

Switch providers per session. Keys live in your browser only — GEM has no server, so we never see them.

### Honest disclosures (the stuff most sellers hide)

- **Trending Mode** uses live Reddit and HackerNews signals (both CORS-friendly). Google Trends has stricter CORS, so by default GEM falls back to `r/popular` as a trending proxy — covers ≈ 95 % of niches well. Power users can run a one-line local proxy for unrestricted Google Trends data (documented in Chapter 7 of the manual).
- **AI output requires review.** GEM gives you a draft, not a publish. Read and edit before anything ships. The Quality Bar refuses generic filler, but the human in the loop is still you.
- **8 GB RAM minimum** for Ollama local mode with 7B models; **16 GB+** recommended for the 14B+ models that give the best JSON quality. Cloud mode works on anything that runs a modern browser.

---

### Built by an operator, for operators

GEM is built by the operator behind **AI Decoded** and **Tools That Work** — covering AI for creators and operator-grade productivity tools, respectively. Every release of GEM is dogfooded on those channels for at least 30 days before it ships to buyers. The Quality Bar checks in v1.7 exist because they had to clear those channels first.

---

### What GEM is *not*

- ❌ Not a chat wrapper — six specialist agents with locked schemas and validated handoff between each
- ❌ Not a SaaS — no server, no database, no account, no monthly fee
- ❌ Not an enterprise sale — Studio tier caps at $149; white-label is a future tier, not today's product
- ❌ Not a daily auto-brief — yet. That's on the roadmap and Founder's Edition buyers shape the order.
